title: One-time pads failed the Soviets only when reused
body: The one-time pad is provably unbreakable with truly random single-use keys, but wartime Soviet clerks, under supply pressure, reused some pad pages. US and British analysts in the Venona project exploited the reuse from 1943 onward, slowly reading thousands of messages. Perfect cryptography was defeated by logistics, the usual assassin of perfect cryptography.
